experiments.verification_method: Two independent routes that agree, plus an arithmetic check. (1) HTML route: curl https://arxiv.org/html/2504.05316v1 (HTML 200, 303805 B), parsed the 12th <table> on the page row-by-row with a Python regex/HTML unescape script; every cell of the last row read 50.77 | 73.78 | 55.91 | 75.36 | 58.28 | 79.70 | 54.99 | 76.28 | 65.64. (2) PDF route: pdftotext -layout paper.pdf paper.txt, the same row at lines 465-466 of paper.txt with identical values and column alignment. (3) Visual route: pdftoppm -f 7 -l 7 -r 160 -png paper.pdf then read page7-07.png as an image; the Table III last row visibly reads PTHA (Ours) / BLIP2 / FashionIQ_MTST / 50.77 73.78 / 55.91 75.36 / 58.28 79.70 / 54.99 76.28 / 65.64, with 'FashionIQMTST' in subscript shading. All three routes agree on every digit. (4) Arithmetic: category macro means recomputed as (50.77+55.91+58.28)/3 = 54.9867 -> 54.99 and (73.78+75.36+79.70)/3 = 76.28; (54.99+76.28)/2 = 65.635 -> 65.64, matching the printed Average and Avg. columns, so the printed averages are internally consistent and are not a per-category value.
